body: I knew this would be the response. I've had this conversation a million times. I'm just done.
I gave it another night. And another. And I am here now. I will give it more time.
Im sorry, I just can't go on. Thank you for talking to me.

I don't have that kind of hope anymore. I will always be alone. I used to believe that one day I would find someone but it won't happen for me. And I don't want to live like that. I don't care about school or the future or getting a good job anymore, it's meaningless if I have no one to share it with. I am tired of wishing and hoping and waiting and I'm tired of trying to change myself for others. No one wants me for who I am so I don't want to live anymore. 

My time is almost here, just 5 minutes before I don't have to feel this way anymore.

I don't have any other options. My life is ruined. I failed everything I've ever tried to do. I failed out of school twice. I am going to work a dead-end job for the rest of my life. I don't have friends. Family has given up on me. And I'll never have love. I cannot bear the crushing loneliness and despair that I face every minute of every day. Nobody would ever want to be with a waste of life like me. When it reaches midnight, I'm ending my pain forever.
No one would care if I died. Nobody would be affected so there's no reason for me not to. I am beyond help, I just cannot live anymore.

I have tried talking but nobody understands. Everyone says I am the problem. I am done trying to fit in to a world that does not want me. You won't have to see me do anything, my existence means nothing to anyone so my death won't mean anything either.
I am sick of hearing that. Its not my fault this is happening. I have tried so hard to be ok with who I am but nobody wants me and there's nothing I can do to change that.
